LinkedAccount.title: LinkedAccount
LinkedAccount.description: Represents an employee or manager account synced to Google Cloud Firestore for cross-device account linking and role-based permission enforcement.

userCode.description: Unique account code matching the document ID (e.g., USR-SD-1001).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the manager/owner who created and manages this account.

linkedUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the employee linked to this account.

fullName.description: Full display name of the employee or manager.

username.description: Login username identifier for the employee.

role.description: Assigned job role (e.g., مدير النظام, محاسب خزنة ومبيعات).

permissions.description: Comma-separated list of screen/module permissions assigned by the manager.

serverSyncToken.description: Unique cloud synchronization token for linking employee devices.

active.description: Whether the employee account is currently active.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/linked_accounts/{accountCode}.description: Stores cloud-linked user accounts and manager-assigned employee permissions.

schema.description: Enterprise cloud ERP central documents for phone and Windows clients (invoices, movements, customers, products, cashboxes).

/erp_clusters/{clusterCode}/{collectionN.description: Enterprise central database synchronization cluster connecting Android phone and Windows desktop clients.
